meta.title: Niky's Kitchen
meta.description: Healthy recipes, articles and an app that tells you what to eat today and how much. No food logging, no guilt.

home.title: Eat with joy, not with guilt.
home.lead: We work out how much you need. Cook one base and give it a different twist every day. And a sweet treat is part of the plan.
home.baseLead: On Sunday, roast one tray of vegetables with quinoa and give it a new twist every day. Less cooking, less shopping, no waste.
home.appTitle: Food from A to Z app
home.appLead: Works out your daily intake, splits it into meals, finds recipes from your fridge and builds a shopping list. Free, no sign-up.
home.aboutLead: I cook healthy food without guilt. I test recipes in my own kitchen and write the way I'd advise a friend.

My day: splits your intake into breakfast, lunch, dinner and a snack
Fridge: finds recipes from what you have at home

about.title: About me
text: I cook healthy food without guilt and without counting every bite. I want healthy eating to be simple, even for people with no time.
That's why I came up with one base, three variations, a sweet treat as part of the plan, and an app that works out how much to eat.
My full story is coming soon.
